paite: Vante'n Pathian thupidan atheisak ua; huihkhua liantak in akhutsuak alangsak hi.
heading: David La / Thilsiam A Pathian Thupina
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

paite: Sun in sun kiang ah thu agensawn a, zan in zan kiang ah theihna asulang sawnsawn hi.
english: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

paite: Thugen himhim leh pau a-om kei a; a-aw uh bil a zak theih ahi kei hi.
english: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.

paite: Atehna khau uh leilung luah tengteng ah zamsuaksak in a-om a; athu uh kawlmong pha in athangkheta hi. Huaite ah ni a ding in puanin azak a,
english: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

paite: huai ni tuh mouneipa ding adantan a kipan pawt bang ahi a, mihattak bang in, ataina lampi a atai ding nuam asa naknak hi.
english: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

paite: Apawtna kawlmong tawp a kipan ahi a, ataikawina atawp lehlam tan in ahi a, asatna a kipan bangmah sel in a-om kei hi.
english: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.

paite: TOUPA dan ahoihkim a, hinna ahalhsak hi; TOUPA thu theihsak amuanhuai a, mimawl apilsak hi.
heading: TOUPA Dan
english: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

paite: TOUPA thuzohna adik a, lungtang akipaksak nak hi. TOUPA thupiak asiangthou a, mitte ahihvak nak hi.
english: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

paite: TOUPA laudan siam asiang a, tangtawn a ding in a-om hi. TOUPA vaihawmnate atak a, akizen kimvel vek ahi.
english: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

paite: Huaite dangka-eng sang in adeihhuaizaw a, ahi, dangka-eng siangthou tampi sang in leng; khuaizu leh khuaikhak sang in leng akhumzaw ahi.
english: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

paite: Huai lou leng huaite in na sikha taihilh in ka om zel hi; huaite zuih ah kipahman thupitak a-om hi.
english: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

paite: Kua'n ahia amah diklouhnate theithei ding? Diklouhna kiselte lak ah hon huikhia in.
english: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

paite: Thil hihkhial teitei lou ding in na sikha hon len tinten inla; ka tung ah amaute thu neisak ke'n! Huchi in hoih in ka om dia, tatlekna thupitak lak ah gensiatbei in ka om ding hi.
english: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka suangpi leh hon tanpa, ka kam a thupawtte leh ka lungtang a ka ngaihtuahnate na mitmuh in pomtak mtak hi hen.
english: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
